what: Condition inverted: on a paused run an APPROVED verdict tells Claude 'Stop here' without committing, while a rejected one tells it to commit the unapproved changes.
dropRoot reports 'dropped' when the engine refused the removal, so a failure is treated as success: the root stays registered and the caller drops its note/retry.
Inverted interactive check: in interactive sessions the full raw report is returned into Claude's context and the pane is never shown; headless runs get the pane message instead of the text.
Inverted sweep condition: unresolved ('unknown') roots are removed from the retry set without being dropped, while resolved ones stay and are re-offered every turn.
Off-by-one: the last approved phase is not marked '(approved)' in the resume context, so a resumed session misreads progress.

_footer checks review.deferred (late-round, non-blocking findings) instead of all_findings, so a CHANGES_REQUIRED with findings but nothing deferred gets the prose-only footer and Claude is told no findings are listed.
